description.zh: 像玩“二十问”：用熵衡量一堆样本有多混乱，每刀选信息增益最大的切法，让混乱下降最快，贪心地长成一棵树；但贪心只看眼前一步，不保证全局最少问题，所以要用深度限制它，别把噪声也学进去。数据是人造的二维两类点。
description.en: Like twenty questions: entropy measures how mixed a pile of samples is, each cut picks the largest information gain so disorder falls fastest, and the tree grows greedily. But greedy looks only one step ahead and does not guarantee the fewest questions overall, so depth limits stop it from learning noise. The data are artificial 2-D two-class points.

reason.zh: 每个区域里各类所占的比例构成一个概率分布，熵衡量它有多混；信息增益就是切分前后熵的减少量。
reason.en: The class shares in a region form a probability distribution and entropy measures how mixed it is; information gain is the drop in entropy caused by a cut.

reason.zh: 树越深，训练准确率只升不降，但对没见过的数据的准确率在有噪声时会先升后降；这是固定数据集上的演示，不是普遍定律。
reason.en: Training accuracy only rises with depth, but accuracy on unseen data rises then falls when there is noise; this is a demonstration on one fixed data set, not a universal law.

title.zh: 怎样用最少的问题把两类分开？
title.en: How can two classes be separated with the fewest questions?

ask.zh: 熵衡量混乱——一刀切下去，怎样算这一刀好不好？
ask.en: Entropy measures disorder — after one cut, how do you judge whether it was a good cut?

ask.zh: 按信息增益挑每一刀，贪心地长树——贪心保证全局最少问题吗？
ask.en: Picking each cut by information gain grows the tree greedily — does greed guarantee the fewest questions overall?

reveal.zh: 每刀选信息增益最大的切法，混乱下降最快；但贪心只看眼前一步，深度限制则是防止学到噪声。
reveal.en: Each cut picks the largest information gain, dropping disorder fastest; but greed only looks one step ahead, and depth limits stop the tree from learning noise.
